resources.string: Add \"Radar\" in Settings, Glyph Interface, Glyph Toys, then hold the Glyph button on the back to cycle to it.
Needs a Nothing Phone (4a) Pro or Phone (3).
The Glyph system service did not answer. Reboot once; if it still fails the ROM does not expose it to third party apps.
Preview of what the back panel draws. If this animates, the renderer works and any problem is in the Glyph connection.
